blocks.text: CAGAYAN DE ORO CITY — The last of the four battalions of the Army’s 10th Infantry Division (ID) deployed to help secure the historic Bangsamoro parliamentary elections on Sept. 14 had returned to its home base, clearing the way for the military to shift gears toward territorial defense. In an email to the Inquirer on Sunday, Maj. Ruben Gadut, 10ID Public Affairs Office head, said the return of the 67th Infantry Battalion marked the final phase of the division’s recall from Western Mindanao, setting into motion plans to form a dedicated Territorial Defense Operations (TDO) Brigade by 2027.
